summary: ZTO Express (Cayman) Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a Hong Kong Stock Exchange Next Day Disclosure Return detailing an ongoing share buyback program. The return lists repurchases of American depositary shares (each representing one Class A ordinary share) between May 20 and June 4, 2026, with prices ranging from USD 22.12 to USD 22.86 per ADS, totaling approximately 2.1 million ADSs. The buybacks are part of a previously authorized repurchase plan; no cancellation or change in total issued shares has occurred yet. The filing is a routine disclosure under Hong Kong listing rules. Watch for continued buyback execution and potential future cancellations.
